title: Benefits Administration Expert
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the team in the operational conversion of Benefits strategic objectives.

* Support policy and implementation process in line with business, legal and compliance requirements.
* Identify process improvement and automation opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.

title: Sr. Procurement Manager Capability & Leadership Development
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Sr. Procurement Manager Capability \& Leadership Development is responsible for shaping the future capabilities of the global Procurement organization. The role owns the Procurement Capability Framework, leads the Advanced Procurement Academy, and drives talent, leadership, and capability development across the function.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 The Sr. Procurement Manager Capability \& Leadership Development is responsible for shaping the future capabilities of the global Procurement organization. The role owns the Procurement Capability Framework, leads the Advanced Procurement Academy, and drives talent, leadership, and capability development across the function.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Capability Strategy \& Transformation
* Own and continuously evolve the global Procurement Capability Framework.
* Anticipate future capability requirements driven by business strategy, AI, digitalization, and evolving Procurement practices.
* Translate business priorities into capability roadmaps, development programs, and career pathways.
* Define capability standards and proficiency levels across Procurement.
* Procurement Academy \& Learning Ecosystem
* Lead the Sandoz Advanced Procurement Academy.
* Develop scalable learning journeys across strategic, commercial, digital, functional, and leadership capabilities.
* Build an integrated learning ecosystem combining training, coaching, mentoring, digital learning, and experiential development.
* Ensure alignment with broader Sandoz growth and development initiatives.
* Build and maintain a network of leading procurement organizations, academic institutions and industry peers to benchmark and incorporate leading capability and leadership development practices.
* Talent \& Leadership Development
* In close partnership with Procurement Leadership and P\&O, shape and execute the Procurement talent, leadership, and capability agenda globally.
* Embed capabilities into recruitment, talent reviews, succession planning, career development, and performance management.
* Strengthen leadership readiness and succession pipelines for critical roles. Design and implement mentoring, coaching, and talent acceleration initiatives in partnership with Procurement Leadership and P\&O.
* Future\-Ready Culture \& Capability
* Drive the development of future\-ready Procurement capabilities and mindsets, including strategic thinking, commercial excellence, leadership, intellectual curiosity, digital and AI fluency, and business value creation.
* In partnership with Procurement Leadership, people managers, and P\&O, strengthen a high\-performance culture rooted in Sandoz values.
* Foster continuous learning, diverse thinking, constructive challenge, and external market orientation to accelerate innovation and impact.
* Capability Measurement \& Continuous Improvement
* Establish capability assessments and organizational capability metrics.
* Monitor capability gaps, learning effectiveness, and leadership readiness.
* Measure business impact and continuously adapt development priorities to evolving business needs.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a strong advantage. 5\-8 years of relevant experience in Procurement, Consulting, Organizational Development, Talent Management, Learning, or Transformation. Procurement experience is an advantage.
* Strong business acumen and a broad understanding of how capability and leadership development support organizational performance and transformation.
* Proven track record in building global capability and leadership development programs.
* Strong understanding of Procurement and future capability trends.
* Experience operating in global, matrix organizations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive adoption across large organizations.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve

title: Senior Analyst– Workday Recruiting
description:
**Job Description**
* Lead the design and configuration of Workday Recruiting modules to support our organization's talent acquisition processes and strategies.
* Translate business requirements into scalable and efficient system configurations, including job requisitions, candidate management, interview scheduling, and reporting functionalities.
* Develop and implement custom solutions within Workday Recruiting to address complex business requirements and enhance system capabilities.
* Utilize Workday Studio, calculated fields, and business process frameworks to extend and customize Workday Recruiting functionalities as needed.
* Collaborate with integration teams to design, configure, and test integrations between Workday Recruiting and other HR systems, third\-party applications, and data sources.
* Ensure seamless data flow and integrity between Workday Recruiting and other systems to support end\-to\-end recruiting processes.
* Provide training and support to HR users, recruiters, and hiring managers on how to effectively use Workday Recruiting features and functionalities.
* Develop training materials, documentation, and job aids to facilitate user adoption and proficiency.
* Continuously evaluate and optimize Workday Recruiting configurations and processes to improve system performance, usability, and efficiency.
* Proactively identify areas for improvement and implement best practices to enhance the overall recruitment experience.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and data privacy standards in Workday Recruiting configurations and processes.
* Collaborate with HR business partners, recruiters, IT teams, and external vendors to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver effective solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR stakeholders, providing expertise and guidance on Workday Recruiting capabilities, industry trends, and best practices.


**Qualifications And Background**
* Workday certification in Recruiting or equivalent experience is required.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in Workday HCM implementation, with a focus on Workday Recruiting modules.
* Proven experience leading Workday Recruiting implementations, including system design, configuration, and integration activities.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, talent acquisition best practices, and industry trends.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Exceptional communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and external partners in a global, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.
